# Story 14.1: Red-phase unit tests for the unified server error mapper

Status: review

## Story

As a developer,
I want red-phase unit tests asserting that all Fastify routes in `apps/server` route their failure responses through one shared per-domain error mapper with the hand-rolled local duplicates gone,
So that Story 14.2 has a defined, executable contract to make pass when it unifies server error handling on a single helper (P0 item #1 from Aspect 9 of the critical review).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A spec asserts that `universe/index.ts` and `universe/add-symbol/index.ts` no longer contain hand-rolled local failure-response handlers, and instead delegate their error responses to one shared per-domain error mapper (the same function reference is used by both routes).
2. A spec asserts that `health/index.ts` produces its 503/500 failure shapes through the same shared per-domain error mapper rather than inline hand-built response objects.
3. A spec asserts behavioral preservation: for each route, the status code and response body produced on a representative failure are identical to the pre-unification values (same codes / bodies as before).
4. All assertions in AC #1–#3 are marked `.skip()` (`it.skip`) so the server Vitest suite runs green BEFORE Story 14.2 exists — red-phase by skip, not by failure. Existing passing server tests remain unskipped and green.
5. The spec file(s) run green under `nx test server` immediately after this story (new red-phase tests skipped), and Story 14.2's first task is to remove the `.skip()` markers, confirm they FAIL against current code, then implement until they pass.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [x] Task 1 (AC: #1): Add a shared-mapper assertion for `universe` and `add-symbol`.
  - [x] 1.1 In a new/updated spec under `apps/server/src/app/routes/universe/`, assert the failure path in `index.ts` calls one shared per-domain error mapper, and that no local hand-rolled handler remains in either `universe/index.ts` or `universe/add-symbol/index.ts`.
- [x] Task 2 (AC: #2): Add a shared-mapper assertion for `health`.
  - [x] 2.1 In the spec under `apps/server/src/app/routes/health/`, assert the 503/500 failure shapes are produced through the same shared mapper, not inline objects.
- [x] Task 3 (AC: #3): Add behavioral-preservation assertions.
  - [x] 3.1 For each of `universe`, `add-symbol`, and `health`, assert a representative failure yields the same status code and body as before unification.
- [x] Task 4 (AC: #4, #5): Mark red-phase assertions `.skip()` and confirm green.
  - [x] 4.1 Apply `it.skip` to every assertion added in Tasks 1–3 — they are red until Story 14.2 unifies the mapper. Leave all pre-existing tests unskipped.
  - [x] 4.2 Run `nx test server` and confirm fully green with only the new red-phase tests skipped. Do NOT weaken or delete any assertion to achieve this — skip markers only.

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** three error-handling styles currently coexist in `apps/server` — `create-error-response.function.ts` (middleware only), hand-rolled local handlers in `universe/index.ts` and `universe/add-symbol/index.ts`, and inline 503 shapes in `health/index.ts`. Unifying on one per-domain mapper removes a whole class of inconsistent failure responses.
- **Red-phase TDD:** this story is ordered before Story 14.2. Assertions are marked `it.skip` so CI stays green while the duplication still exists; Story 14.2's first task removes the skip markers, confirms red, then unifies until green.
- **Do NOT modify production code in this story** — unit-test scaffold only. The unification belongs to Story 14.2.
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; server tests run via `nx test server`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Create/modify specs under `apps/server/src/app/routes/universe/` and `apps/server/src/app/routes/health/` (add skipped shared-mapper + behavioral-preservation assertions).
- No changes to production `.ts` route handlers in this story.
